Targets derived from Feature 7.2 algorithmic rules. Model learns to replicate rule patterns, not confirmed ground-truth land-use change. Label noise and systematic biases from the rule logic propagate to model evaluation.
Experiment C (MH-003): TP=159, FP=419, FN=0. The model achieves 100% recall at the cost of high false positives. This is a screening-mode behavior but limits precision.
Experiment A (MH-001): TP=34, FN=228. Low recall on MH-001. The model misses the majority of positive candidates in this project.
MH-001: 10.8%, MH-002: 12.0%, MH-003: 20.4% (F8.7-C populations). Different prevalences affect all threshold-dependent metrics.
All 3 projects are from the same geographic region and regulatory context. Generalization to climatically or ecologically distinct environments is not established.
No field-verified samples are available. Model performance is estimated entirely against algorithmic label proxies.
Inter-annual delta CNN is a black-box. Attribution of predictions to spectral bands or temporal patterns requires additional work (e.g. saliency maps).
